steps.line: * When palantir is built for release
* Then its executable holds no code from an inspector target

expect.why: the release executable defines no symbol from the inspector target

steps.line: * And launching it with the inspector launch flag creates no socket

expect.that: (.launched.pid | tostring) as $p | [.listedAtLaunch, .listedAfter2s, .listedAfter7s] | all((.exit == 0 or .exit == 2) and ((.sockets // []) | map(select((.pid | tostring) == $p)) | length == 0))
expect.why: at launch, 2 s and 7 s later, no palantir socket lists the release palantir's pid
at launch, 2 s and 7 s later, asking the release palantir for its state finds no socket to answer
